transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?
Lately I can’t seem to keep my actions in order at work. I start doing things that don’t fit what I’m supposed to be doing and everything just turns into a mess.
Have you struggled with these difficulties with focus and organization since you were a child, or is this a relatively new change for you?

No, this is a pretty new change for me. I used to be really detailed and organized, like when I would plan out fishing trips and woodworking projects down to the last detail. But these problems only started about a year ago after I left community college to work full-time at the warehouse.
Along with these difficulties organizing your tasks, have you experienced any periods where your mood or energy felt unusually high, or on the flip side, very low and depressed?

No, I haven't really had times where my energy was super high or where I felt really depressed. My main struggle is just feeling confused and mixed up, and not being able to organize my actions. It's more about everything turning into a mess rather than extreme shifts in my mood.
Around the time these difficulties started a year ago, did you experience any head injuries, major illnesses, or other physical medical conditions?
No, I don't recall having any head injuries, major illnesses, or other physical medical conditions around that time. Physically, everything was pretty normal for me.
Have you noticed yourself becoming more distant from family and friends, or losing interest in hobbies you used to love, like fishing or woodworking, over this past year?

Yeah, I don't really do any woodworking or plan fishing trips anymore because I just can't keep things organized like I used to. My family and people at church have also been avoiding putting me in charge of things because I can't follow through. It feels like they're keeping their distance because I'm so out of step.
Over the past year, have you experienced seeing or hearing things that others cannot, or holding strong beliefs that other people find unusual?

No, I haven't experienced seeing or hearing things that aren't there, and I don't have any unusual beliefs. My main struggle is just that my thoughts and actions get completely mixed up and out of order.
Along with losing interest in your hobbies, have you noticed feeling emotionally flat, indifferent, or like you don't experience emotions as strongly as you used to?
I haven't really noticed feeling emotionally flat or indifferent. My emotions feel pretty normal, it's just that I'm constantly struggling to keep my actions and thoughts in order.
Have you found it harder lately to motivate yourself to do basic daily tasks, like keeping up with your personal hygiene, cooking, or cleaning around the house?

No, I haven't really noticed any lack of motivation or problems with basic things like my hygiene, cooking, or cleaning. Those daily routines are fine. My struggle is really just trying to keep my thoughts and actions organized so everything doesn't turn into a mess.
To help me rule out other causes, have you been using any recreational drugs, alcohol, or new medications over this past year?
No, I don't use any recreational drugs or drink alcohol. I'm also not taking any medications.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a progressive decline in occupational and social functioning over the past year, characterized by an inability to organize thoughts and actions, loss of interest in previously enjoyed hobbies (woodworking and fishing), and social withdrawal. These symptoms have developed slowly without any history of positive psychotic symptoms (such as hallucinations or delusions), manic or depressive episodes, or organic/substance-induced etiologies, which is characteristic of simple schizophrenia.
